title: coscene level
description: One level. The engine reads initialState and validationRules according to archetypeId; see docs/level-schema.md for the shape each archetype expects.

id.description: Unique across all packs. Bundled levels use pNN-lNN.

place.description: Chapter number. 0 is reserved for daily scenes.

index.description: Position inside the place, starting at 1.

i18nKey.description: Base dictionary key. '<i18nKey>.objective' and '<i18nKey>.reveal' must exist in every language.

conceptId.description: The idea named on the reveal sheet. 'concept.<conceptId>.name', '.idea' and '.seen' must exist.

textParams.description: Values substituted into {placeholders} in the objective, reveal and hints.

hints.description: Dictionary keys of the progressive hints, mildest first.

initialState.description: Where everything starts: positions, anchors, bounds, movable parts and targets.

validationRules.description: Tolerances and win-condition parameters, judged by the engine when the player submits.
